name: shuki
description: A home inventory and shopping list you talk to, in Hebrew. A PWA for the whole household, with an LLM (Claude or ChatGPT) that proposes changes you approve.

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

DB.description: The house's database (D1). Created for you.

SETUP_CODE.description: 8 digits you choose. You type them in the app once, to create the house.
